digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: The Verified workflow dispatch volume on main, not tickets branch pushes, dominates repository-local Actions job queue depth during incident periods, with seven patchsets in five minutes reaching 22 waiting jobs and 873s runner wait times.

The current Verified workflow graph executes 17 runner jobs per full-route patchset without mutation shards and up to 24 jobs with all seven shards selected, creating immediate fan-out demand of 13 runnable jobs that can saturate the Free plan's 20 concurrent job limit.

Repository-local queue measurements during current-shape bursts show three independent patchsets reaching 22 waiting jobs with maximum 15 running, consistent with shared organization-level contention on the navapbc Free plan (20 total / 5 macOS concurrency limit).

Four mutually exclusive first-move options exist: bundle four preflights to reduce per-run slots, add debounce logic to coalesce superseded patchsets, move macOS coverage to scheduled branch health, or upgrade the organization plan; Option A (demand reduction with coverage parity) is recommended as the lowest-risk intervention.
